# spot_autopilotnodepool (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing autopilot node pool by name.
data "spot_autopilotnodepool" "example" {
  name = "c126b90d-00d1-48fb-92ae-b8c88e27f511"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the autopilotnodepool
- `name` (String) Name of the autopilotnodepool

### Read-Only

- `allocation_strategy` (String) Allocation strategy.
- `allocations` (Attributes List) Per-class allocation breakdown. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations))
- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations applied to the nodes.
- `budget_per_hour` (String) Hourly budget (USD) read as a bid ceiling.
- `cloudspace_name` (String) The name of the cloudspace the resulting nodes join.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels applied to the nodes.
- `managed_memory_gb` (String) Won memory (GB).
- `managed_vcpus` (Number) Won vCPUs.
- `memory_per_vcpu` (String) Memory-to-vCPU ratio in GB.
- `phase` (String) Fulfillment phase.
- `region` (String) Region whose server classes are eligible.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Taints applied to the nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))
- `target_vcpus` (Number) vCPU target.
- `vcpu` (Attributes) Total vCPU target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vcpu))
- `vcpu_per_node` (Attributes) Per-node vCPU bounds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vcpu_per_node))

<a id="nestedatt--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations`

Read-Only:

- `bid_price_per_hour` (String) Bid price per hour (USD) placed for this class.
- `desired_nodes` (Number) Desired node count for this allocation.
- `market_price_per_hour` (String) Market clearing price per hour (USD) for this class.
- `memory_gb_per_node` (String) Memory (GB) per node for this class.
- `server_class` (String) The server class fulfilling this allocation.
- `spot_node_pool` (String) Name of the child SpotNodePool fulfilling this allocation.
- `vcpu_per_node` (Number) vCPUs per node for this class.
- `won_nodes` (Number) Won node count for this allocation.


<a id="nestedatt--taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `taints`

Read-Only:

- `effect` (String) Taint effect.
- `key` (String) Taint key.
- `value` (String) Taint value.


<a id="nestedatt--vcpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcpu`

Read-Only:

- `total` (Number) Total vCPUs to fill.


<a id="nestedatt--vcpu_per_node"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcpu_per_node`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) Maximum vCPUs per node.
- `min` (Number) Minimum vCPUs per node.
